body:
Founder ask: build Selenium bindings into PARENA. First real blocker found: net/tcp.prn had zero working host implementation (FFI declared, never implemented) and a Result-boxing bug that meant it never actually compiled to valid C either. Fixed both: real tcp_connect_impl/tcp_listen_impl/tcp_accept_impl/tcp_read_impl/tcp_write_impl/tcp_close_impl in runtime/parena_runtime.h (real getaddrinfo+socket+connect BSD sockets, same house style as io.prn's raw_*_impl), plus renamed the public API (connect/listen/accept/read/write/close -> tcp-connect/tcp-listen/tcp-accept/tcp-read/tcp-write/tcp-close) after finding those names collide with literal libc functions once any system header is included -- VS0 emits top-level defn names as bare unprefixed C identifiers, no module mangling for a module's own definitions. Live-verified against the real running IDUNA service on :8080 (real HTTP/1.1 GET, real 200 OK JSON response received back through compiled PARENA-generated C), not just compiled. make test: 336/336 still green. PARENA commit b0fe56b.

⚓ ☃
title: Real BSD socket host glue for net/tcp.prn -- first working PARENA network I/O
